tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Searches the UNIALL index of tokenized real-world assets by free-text query (name, ticker, issuer) and filters for category, chain, issuer, underlying ticker, AUM, transfer standard and verification. Use `underlying` (e.g. QQQ) to return only wrappers of that spot underlier — leveraged/inverse produ

tools.name: compare_underlying
tools.description: Lists every tokenized deployment of one spot underlying ticker (e.g. QQQ, SPY, NVDA), grouped by issuer with verified-first ordering. Uses the same issuer-suffix peel as taxonomy integrity (ON / x / B / Reality R). Excludes leveraged and inverse products of that underlier.

tools.name: get_asset_summary
tools.description: Returns a sourced fact sheet for one UNIALL asset by id, including missing_fields and unsourced_fields. Verified legal_entity / issuer_jurisdiction / issuer include source_url and evidence when the verification system has them; otherwise source_url is null and the field is listed in unsourced_fields

tools.name: check_transferability
tools.description: Returns the on-chain transfer restriction standard for a token and, when a wallet address is provided, whether that address can *receive* it (simulates a transfer TO the wallet from a known holder, or a whitelist recipient check). Returns transferable="unknown" when a receive check cannot be perform

tools.name: get_index_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate UNIALL index counts for assets, verified assets, issuers, chains, deployments, and categories. Useful for a high-level snapshot of index coverage.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Answers whether a given investor profile can buy or hold one UNIALL asset, and why. Combines sourced offering rules with the on-chain transferability oracle. Returns ELIGIBLE | NOT_ELIGIBLE | REQUIRES_ONBOARDING | UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN when rules are missing or older than 90 days. Informational only.

tools.name: screen_eligible_assets
tools.description: Screens the UNIALL index for assets this investor profile can buy or hold (ELIGIBLE or REQUIRES_ONBOARDING). SQL-filters offering rules first; on-chain checks only for the current page. Informational only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_assets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
